name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description: A hip hinge lifting one kettlebell from between your feet: push your hips back, grip the handle with both hands, and stand up tall.
setup: Stand with feet a little wider than hip-width, the kettlebell on the floor between them.
Hinge down and hold the handle with both hands.
cues: Drive through your feet and stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

prescription.note: Warm up with lighter sets first. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Set up
keyframes.cue: Hips back, both hands on the handle.

keyframes.name: Stand up
keyframes.cue: Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
